description: Defines an abstract Scala actor class that combines the functionalities of AbstractActorWithTimers and Stash in the Akka framework, providing an actor with message stashing and timer capabilities.

classes.name: AbstractActorWithStashWithTimers
classes.description: An abstract Scala class extending Akka's AbstractActorWithTimers and Stash, serving as a base for actors requiring timer and stash functionalities.
